build_inshop_train_dataset: build an InShop dataset instance with split set to train for image retrieval training
build_inshop_query_dataset: build an InShop dataset instance with split set to query for image retrieval evaluation
build_inshop_gallery_dataset: build an InShop dataset instance with split set to gallery for image retrieval gallery
process_inshop_annotations: process InShop annotation file to parse train query and gallery image labels
load_inshop_data_list: load the InShop data list returning images and labels for the current split
